description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

RallyBoard is hiring a Product Engineer to take product features from user problems through production and ongoing improvement. The role also involves working with founders and engineers, scaling infrastructure and integrations, and participating in an on-call rotation.
Product Engineer shipping product features on Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase/Postgres, and scaling infrastructure and integrations

Responsibilities:
• Take features from the user problem to production on our stack (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres): write the spec, direct a team of agents to build it, and review their output for correctness, UX and craft
• Stay with what you shipped after launch: watch logs, errors and how people actually use it, and fix what isn't right
• Work directly with the founders and our engineering team: 80% tactical, 20% strategic
• Scale our infrastructure, tooling, and integrations for the next stage of growth
• Take your turn on our on-call rotation: one week at a time, business hours only

Requirements:
• About **a year** inside a real engineering team (an apprenticeship, rotational program, contract seat or internship counts)
• You use coding agents every day (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar) and you're critical of their output
• You've shipped something people actually used, at work or on your own, and can walk us through the decisions behind it
• Fast learner with a good attitude: you've taught yourself something new recently, and you stay constructive when things get messy
• Proof you build: a live product we can open, ideally something hard you built
• Strong written English
• Authorized to work in the US. We can't sponsor visas

Preferred:
• Recently finished a big-tech apprenticeship, rotational program or contract seat
• Startup or early-stage experience
• Next.js, React, Supabase/PostgreSQL experience
• Hackathons, open source, or a side project with real users
